purpose: Close a bounded APNG frame-data gap for packed low-bit and 16-bit PNG image samples without claiming full APNG/PNG conformance.

external_anchors.used_for: PNG bit-depth restrictions by color type, packed sample scanline sizing, filter method 0 reconstruction, PLTE/tRNS rules, IDAT image data, and APNG fdAT frame-data inheritance.

notes: This lab validates deterministic non-interlaced APNG frame data for packed 1/2/4-bit samples and 16-bit samples only.
It covers full-canvas source frames with filter method 0 filter types 0..4 and split fdAT continuation chunks.
It does not claim full APNG/PNG conformance, live editor preservation, or final production carrier selection.
next_research_step: Keep remaining APNG/PNG work scoped to explicit image-data fixtures, live external editor preservation, or final carrier selection evidence before claiming full conformance.
